observations.title: The giant Bronze Age ritual dagger found in a field in Norfolk
observations.page_title: The giant Bronze Age ritual dagger found in a field in Norfolk
observations.page_description: The Rudham Dirk, an oversize Bronze Age ritual dagger that was famously used for years as a doorstop by a Norfolk farmer It is 800 years older than the ancient city of Rome and is even older than the Pharaoh...
observations.provenance_excerpt:
overed in Norfolk in 1988. 
 The National Heritage Memorial Fund paid for the Rudham ritual dagger and it is now in the collection of Norwich Castle Museum and Art Gallery.
